svg.title: Pacific voyaging, communities & modern states
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Voyaging and cultural connections alongside selected modern constitutional transitions. These are not branches of a single Pacific empire. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
